title: Edits API (POST /v1/edits) removed
summary: The legacy Edits endpoint and its SDK helpers were shut down on 2024-01-04. The text-davinci-edit-001 / code-davinci-edit-001 models are no longer served.
body: OpenAI retired the Edits API. Migrate edit-style workflows to Chat Completions with gpt-4o / gpt-4o-mini using editing prompts, or use the Responses API.
migration: Replace client.edits.create({ model: 'text-davinci-edit-001', input, instruction }) with client.chat.completions.create({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: `${instruction}\n\n${input}` }] }). Update raw HTTP callers from POST https://api.openai.com/v1/edits to POST https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions.

title: Legacy Completions models text-davinci-003 retired
summary: The text-davinci-003 / text-davinci-002 models served via POST /v1/completions were retired on 2024-01-04.
body: Legacy completion models are no longer available. Use a current model through Chat Completions instead.
migration: Move from completions.create({ model: 'text-davinci-003', prompt }) to chat.completions.create({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }] }). In go-openai use ChatCompletionRequest with GPT4oMini / GPT35Turbo.
